outcome.technical: tests/test_stamp_verification.py. (a) New `_judged(root, man, cmd, key, *extra)` hands `red_verdict` the runs recorded under `_RECORDED[key]` over the fixture's real repository, reading it as `run_red` does (declared_tests, _at_head, dependency_plan, head_tree, _cat_blobs, new_stages, child_env, and for a sweep command load_sweep_table/sized_deadline/sweep_budget); it refuses (exit None, payload `record`) a record holding or lacking a second or fix run against `_wants_second` and classify_run+baseline_problem, so a change to those decisions turns the literal case red. `_proof(root, man, cmd, key)` dispatches real vs judged; `_suite_red`, `_extra_red`, `_label_red`, `_path_red` take `key=`. 88 recorded runs over 72 cases now judged: sr99 sr117-121 sr126 ns1-5 (sr-red-baseline), sr145-150 sr153 sr157-159 sr161 (sr-reach), sr164-166 sr168-170 (sr-moved), sr175-181 sr184 sr185 (sr-binding), sr136-138 (sr-every-run-isolated), sr107 sr109 sr110 (sr-round5), sr51 sr52 (sr-label), sr74 sr88 sr127 sr128 (sr-green), sr16 sr18 sr20 (sr-introduces), sr81-84, sr57 sr58 sr60, sr93 sr103, sr70 sr71, sr67, sr56, swc2 swc8, swn2-4, sd3. Each record was CAPTURED from that case's own real proof in a HEAD export (a wrapper on M.red_verdict), the throwaway path scrubbed to `<holder>`, tally lines built from `_TALLY`, sweep totals from `_sweep_total`, sweep rows' counts %-formatted; texts used twice or more are `_RUN_<KEY>_<RUN>` constants; `_U_EQ`/`_U_DASH` for unittest's 70-char rules. The comment above `_RECORDED` names the real proof kept per dialect: house sr1+sr50, staged house swd6, unittest-as-script and -f sr102, `python -m unittest` sr167, `sh -c` sr160, jest-shaped runner via node_modules sd1, stand-in sweep swc1, real sweep swn1. Kept real on purpose: sr101 (converting it lost 5 module lines - `_file_sha` except-OSError and `_lay_over`'s removal of a deleted declared file - so it was reverted), isolation cases sr129 sr130 sr132 sr134 sr135 sr142-144, sr-directory (its subject is the lay-over of a declared directory), sd1 sd2 sd4 sd5, swc1 swc9, swn0 swn1, and every deliberate-sleep block (swd, sr-sigterm, sr-process, sr-budget, sr-run-confirm) untouched. Labels narrowed honestly: sr138 (checks payload baseline.stubbed instead of the head run's exit), sr136 (HEAD's red run is not a green baseline, no longer 'is not skipped'), sd3 (the dependency plan links node_modules; now also asserts the basis says so). (b) 44 sub-second blocks plus swt-wall/swp-platform merged into six subject blocks su-readers (14), su-verdict (7), su-sweep-table (2), su-env (10), su-wording (4), su-records (8): each member runs under `_harness.stage` with its old label, called by name through a lambda because `_harness.stage_reach` reads calls (a first version passing the function objects failed 'STAGED BLOCKS NEVER RUN'). STAGES 79 -> 40 rows. (c) `_seeded_repo` builds one template per process (`_SEED_TEMPLATE`) under fixture_root and copies it with shutil.copytree(symlinks=True, dirs_exist_ok=True) into a fresh fixture_root; removal stays atexit remove_tree; no rmtree added. .github/sweep-costs.json: the 44 dropped labels' rows removed by record_costs(labels=every suite's current rows, this suite's stage_labels) from its own figures, platform windows-2025 and workers 4 as swd7 does; no figure re-recorded; this suite 462.3 -> 400.2 = sum of its 34 remaining rows; no other suite's row changed.
